Why choose the University of Sheffield

Study

Explore undergraduate study at Sheffield

Make Sheffield the start of something special. When you study here you get one of the best student experiences in the UK.

Take the next step with postgraduate study

Explore taught courses and research degrees. Deepen your knowledge and find a path that fits your ambitions.

PhD study

At Sheffield, you’ll join a supportive community of scholars who share your passion.

Online information sessions

Our online sessions help you find out about different aspects of University life.

A world top-100 university

We are proud to be recognised as one of the top 100 universities in the world.

Research and impact

Helping stroke survivors regain their independence

A UK-wide trial led by the University of Sheffield is exploring whether vagus nerve stimulation with rehabilitation can help the brain recover after a stroke and improve independence.

Improving everyday life after a stroke

Research that changes lives

Our centres of excellence are taking an interdisciplinary approach to the biggest challenges facing the planet.

Our impact

Our researchers are making life-changing discoveries and solving problems that have a global impact.

Feed your curiosity

The University of Sheffield Player is the place to discover and explore videos, podcasts and digital exhibitions about our research.
